subject: Annual planning & QBR kickoff — budget, OKR scenarios, timelines
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 5 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Annual planning & QBR kickoff — budget, OKR scenarios, timelines

Hi team,

Kicking off annual planning and QBR prep. Goal for this thread: align on targets and owners and get scenario numbers back so the finance deck and exec QBR draft are ready by Jan 20. High-level asks below — please treat this as the single source for early inputs.

What I need from each org owner by EOD Tue Jan 12:
- Top-line targets (ARR / revenue target or growth %) for three scenarios: conservative, base, ambitious.
- Two slides worth of narrative: key bets, top risks, and 1–2 metrics to watch.
- Any incremental headcount asks or major one-time spend (amount + brief justification).

Deliverables we will assemble:
- Consolidated scenario sheet (attached template: 2027-annual-planning-template.xlsx)
- Draft QBR deck with scenario summary and ask slides
- One-page exec summary of recommended plan

Timeline (compressed):
- Jan 5: Kickoff (this email)
- Jan 7–12: Org owners submit numbers + narratives
- Jan 13–15: Finance + Product synthesize into draft deck
- Jan 20: Exec review of draft QBR

Owners and coordination:
- Finance lead: Markus Klein (financial modeling + sensitivity)
- GTM / ARR assumptions: Laura Bennett
- Platform / cost assumptions: Vivek Kulkarni
- Cross-org consolidator: Monica Patel (I’ll ask Monica to compile the sheet)

Notes on scenarios: keep assumptions explicit (FX/headcount ramp/date, pricing). For modeling, use three scenarios: conservative (lower growth, tighter hiring), base (most likely), ambitious (accelerated growth with incremental spend). Markus — if you want a slightly different cost bucket breakdown, flag it now.

Attachments: 2027-annual-planning-template.xlsx (sheet with scenario tabs), sample cost-scenarios-v1.csv for reference.

I’ll book a short 30m alignment slot next week to walk through expectations and answer any clarifying Qs.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
VP, Strategy & Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 6 Jan 2027 10:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Annual planning & QBR kickoff — budget, OKR scenarios, timelines

Tessa — thanks for the clear ask. I started a quick pass on numbers and attached a CSV (cost-scenarios-v1.csv) with headcount-sensitive projections. Quick notes:

- Preliminary ranges (monthly run-rate impact):
  • Conservative: 0–4% net ARR growth; minimal hiring in H1; focus on retention
  • Base: 8–12% net ARR growth; phased hiring (mostly infra & product)
  • Ambitious: 18–25% net ARR growth; accelerated GTM spend + 12–15% headcount increase

- Need guidance on how to treat reserved capacity revenue from Dedicated — recognize up-front or spread? FinanceOps (external) policy differs by contract type; copying Markus marked internally for modeling but we should confirm.

Questions for owners:
1) For headcount ramp, do we assume 50% of hires filled by EOY or a linear ramp?
2) Are there any one-time infra investments planned for H1?

I’ll continue to refine and will share a versioned sheet by Jan 11.

—Markus
Director, Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 7 Jan 2027 08:05:00 -0800

Thanks Tessa — I’ve started drafting ARR assumptions and pulled funnel conversion changes we saw in Q4. A few clarifying points:

- Are we aligning to FY27 or a rolling-12 definition for the ARR targets? I prefer FY27 (calendar) for the executive deck but want to be explicit.
- For GTM-driven scenarios, I recommend we include a conservative customer expansion assumption (+3% net expansion) vs. base (+8%) vs. ambitious (+15%).

I dropped a link to the QBR draft outline in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDefGQ_anual_planning — Monica, can you add the raw org inputs to the template?

Also, tagging Vivek — platform cost assumptions will materially change unit economics if we accept the ambitious scenario. Want to sync on where we can compress costs without degrading latency SLOs.

Laura Bennett
